station_queried_fraction: 已查同站代表数/全部同站代表数
remaining_best_partition_distance_min: 剩余意向分区到当前最佳分区的最小成对连接差异
remaining_best_partition_distance_mean: 上述成对连接差异的均值
remaining_best_partition_distance_max: 上述成对连接差异的最大值
remaining_seen_nearest_distance_mean: 每个剩余分区到最近已查同站分区的差异，再取均值
remaining_seen_nearest_distance_max: 上述最近已查差异的最大值
remaining_novel_partition_fraction: 没有相同成对连接签名的剩余分区占比
remaining_current_partition_distance_mea: 剩余分区到当前实际分区的平均成对连接差异
station_legal_reward_std: 同站已查合法、未结束、有限正rho反馈的奖励总体标准差
station_best_runnerup_reward_gap: 同站已查可接纳奖励第一名与第二名之差；不足两例填0
station_runnerup_missing: 同站已查可接纳反馈不足两例的指示量
station_legal_feedback_fraction: 同站已查反馈合法、未结束、有限正rho的比例
station_other_best_minus_outside_best: 排除当前最佳后，同站可接纳最好奖励减站外可接纳最好奖励；任一缺失填0，沿用原station_support_missing
incumbent_clearance_to_limit: rho_limit-incumbent_rho；原特征的确定组合，不是新观测
incumbent_clearance_to_safe: 0.9-incumbent_rho；原特征的确定组合，不是新观测
current_overload_excess_mean: 当前在线线路max(rho-1,0)之和/在线线路数
station_incident_max_rho: 当前最佳站所接在线线路最大rho；无在线接线填0
station_incident_overload_share: 该站所接过载在线线路数/全网过载在线线路数；无过载填0

structure: Use current state, masked/deduplicated public action commands and known candidate membership. Intended bus assignment fills unspecified commands from current topology, applies explicit bus changes and line disconnects; partition features describe action intentions, not solved future power flow. Same-bus pair relation is invariant to swapping bus1/bus2.
